title: Root demotion via forged DIO version spoofing
description: A ROOT node accepts any DIO with a 'newer' lollipop version for its DODAG and calls _adopt_version(), which sets role to UNJOINED (line 231). An attacker can demote the root by sending a DIO with version in the linear region (0-127), which is always considered newer than circular values (128-255). This disrupts the entire routing domain. The code assumes link-layer authentication but does not verify it before state transitions.
close_reason: Already fixed: Root now ignores all DIOs (lines 184-188). The vulnerable _adopt_version() call was removed - roots are the authoritative source for DODAG version and cannot be demoted by forged DIOs.
